# XY Forever serial protocol 1.15: file commands

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.15](../PROTOCOL.md).

### 0x14 `file.list`

List one folder, a page at a time. One page of a folder's entries in the file system's order, without `.` and `..`; at most 1016 bytes of entries (a reply never
passes `max_read`) and 64 entries per page. Each page opens the folder, passes over `skip` entries and closes it again, so a folder that changes between pages
may show an entry twice or not at all; a page with `more` 1 may hold no entries. A path the device's file policy refuses (outside `/yaffs2`, an empty, `.` or
`..` part, a control byte) is `refused`; a request whose length does not match its path is `bad_request`; a folder that does not exist (or a file) is
`not_found`. Reads only: the write window stays as it is.

| Request field (12 to 244 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | cstr UTF-8, 8..240 B | absolute folder path, `/yaffs2` or below, NUL-terminated; a trailing `/` is allowed |
| `skip` | u32 | entries to pass over first: 0, then the previous `skip` plus `count` while `more` is 1 |

| Reply field, after the status (8 to 1024 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | u32 | entries in this page |
| `more` | u32 | 0 = the folder ends in this page; 1 = ask again with skip + count. Whether the listing goes on |
| `entries` | rest, 0..1016 B | `count` entries, each `{u8 kind (0 file, 1 folder, 2 other), u32 size (bytes; 0 for a folder), u8 name_bytes, name}`: the name as UTF-8 bytes, 1 to 255 of them, without the folder or a NUL |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `refused`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`. The reply never gains fields (it ends in `rest`). Tool timeout:
30 s. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.5.

### 0x15 `file.delete`

Delete one file. Removes the file through the device's write window (opened by the first change, closed by the device 8 s after the last one, as
`file.write_staged`). Never `/yaffs2` itself, `/yaffs2/bootloader.dev` or `/yaffs2/upgrade` and anything inside it (any ASCII case, any spelling, also through a
link; 1.13): `refused`, as every path the file policy refuses and every path outside `file.write_staged`'s write area; a wrong confirmation is `sha`. A missing
file is `not_found`; a folder (error 21) or any other failure `storage`.

| Request field (42 to 272 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | cstr UTF-8, 10..240 B | absolute path of a file in the write area (`file.write_staged`; 1.13: all of `/yaffs2/` but the marker and `upgrade/`), NUL-terminated |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | confirmation: the SHA-256 of the path bytes, without the NUL |

| Reply field, after the status (4 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | u32 | the device file system's error number (0 when none; 2 no such object, 21 a folder, 93 a folder not empty) |

On an error: every field (zero where not reached). Errors: `bad_request`, `refused`, `sha`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`. Tool timeout: 60 s. **Destructive**:
ask the user first. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.5.

### 0x16 `file.rmdir`

Remove one empty folder. As `file.delete`, for an empty folder only: a folder that still holds entries is `state` (error 93; remove them first); a file
(error 20) or any other failure is `storage`.

| Request field (42 to 272 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | cstr UTF-8, 10..240 B | absolute path of a folder in the write area (as `file.delete`), NUL-terminated |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | confirmation: the SHA-256 of the path bytes, without the NUL |

| Reply field, after the status (4 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | u32 | the device file system's error number (0 when none; 2 no such object, 20 not a folder, 93 not empty) |

On an error: every field (zero where not reached). Errors: `bad_request`, `refused`, `sha`, `state`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`. Tool timeout: 60 s.
**Destructive**: ask the user first. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.5.

### 0x17 `file.mkdir`

Create one folder. Creates one folder through the write window (as `file.delete`). A missing parent is `not_found`; a name that exists already (error 17) or any
other failure is `storage`. Paths the file policy refuses are `refused`.

| Request field (42 to 272 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | cstr UTF-8, 10..240 B | absolute path of the new folder in the write area (as `file.delete`), NUL-terminated; its parent must exist |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | confirmation: the SHA-256 of the path bytes, without the NUL |

| Reply field, after the status (4 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | u32 | the device file system's error number (0 when none; 2 the parent is missing, 17 the name exists) |

On an error: every field (zero where not reached). Errors: `bad_request`, `refused`, `sha`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`. Tool timeout: 60 s. **Destructive**:
ask the user first. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.5.
